messages:
arun: heads up — started seeing a cluster of GPU nodes stuck in Provisioning because container image pulls to /var/lib/kubelet are timing out. noticed in us-west1 and eu-west1 around 02:20 UTC.

maria: seeing same, pods in CrashLoopBackOff with `ImagePullBackOff` and `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`? or timeouts?

arun: mostly timeouts. docker logs show repeated TCP resets when reaching our image registry and model-storage S3 gateway. low-level netstat shows many sockets in TIME_WAIT and high SNAT port usage on nodes.

julie: could be SNAT port exhaustion from sidecar egress policies + continuous batch downloads from model puller during scale-up. we changed sidecar config last week to force all outbound through envoy egress gateway, remember?

arun: yup. envoy stats show thousands of upstream connections in CLOSE_WAIT. envoy admin shows per-host connection limits bumped but NAT ports on nodes still saturated.

leo: quick dump of iptables/nat from one affected node: ```
# iptables -t nat -L -n
Chain POSTROUTING (policy ACCEPT)
 target     prot opt source               destination
 MASQUERADE  all  --  10.0.0.0/16          0.0.0.0/0
```
plus conntrack count near 65000.

maria: oh — MASQUERADE is for the whole pod CIDR, but our egress gateway does source-preserve for certain CIDR ranges, so a lot of pods are getting SNATed by node. combined with short-lived pulls -> port churn.

arun: consequence: kubelet retries hitting registry -> backoff -> cluster autoscaler thinks nodes can't progress -> GPU provisioning stalls. we're blocked on model image pulls for tens of nodes.

infra-bot: incident registered: INC-2026-042 — "node image-pull timeouts due to SNAT port depletion via egress gateway". Pager assigned to @ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: oncall here. rolled a quick mitigation: added a temporary policy to bypass envoy egress gateway for registry/model-storage hosts (10.23.0.0/16 and registry.redwood-inference.internal) so traffic uses node SNAT directly but with expanded ephemeral port range. applied to us-west1 first.

julie: what exactly was changed? config snippet?

ops-oncall: patched egress-policy ConfigMap: ```yaml
egress:
  bypass:
    - hosts: ["registry.redwood-inference.internal", "model-storage.svc.cluster.local"]
    - cidrs: ["10.23.0.0/16"]
``` applied -> reloaded envoy via ctl plane. also increased /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range to `10000 65535` and bumped conntrack max to 200000 on nodes.

maria: nice. any measurable effect?

arun: in us-west1, image pulls recovered within ~2 minutes after change. kubelet node provisioning resumed, pods started pulling layers concurrently again.

leo: but this is a bandaid. root cause is the sidecar+egress gateway funneling many ephemeral connections while not preserving source ports or reusing them effectively, plus Envoy keeping many half-closed tcp states.

julie: long term options we discussed: 1) prefer hostNetwork for heavy model-pull init containers so they avoid sidecar entirely, 2) configure egress gateway to do full SNAT pooling (port-preserving NAT) or use a NAT gateway appliance per nodepool, 3) implement persistent download cache in regional object store to reduce concurrent pulls.

arun: also propose a change to policy: allow registry+model-storage to bypass envoy by default for gpu-nodepool namespaces. PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/3124 — adds exception list and doc.

maria: tracked perf/risk — bypassing envoy reduces centralized observability for these flows. we should add metrics at node-level (tokenized labels) and instrument downloads to keep visibility.

ops-oncall: agreed. action items: 1) merge PR #3124 after 24h review, 2) roll hostNetwork initcontainer pattern in pinner jobs PR #3127, 3) schedule infra week to prototype NAT gateway (owner: leo), 4) write runbook for SNAT exhaustion (owner: arun).

julie: filing postmortem stub now. will include timeline, affected node counts per region, mitigations, and cost impact: autoscaler delayed ~20min causing extra short-lived nodes (~$1200 estimate across regions).

leo: note for prod-hardening: add e2e test that simulates bulk image pulls while egress gateway is enabled to catch this earlier.

arun: anyone see any leftover 5xx errors from the model-storage after the bypass?

maria: one spike of 502 from the gateway shortly after we toggled rules, but no sustained errors. logs show envoy restarted route config and then resumed normal.

infra-bot: reminder: schedule change freeze 72h for PR #3124 after merge to avoid config churn during rollback window.

ops-oncall: I'm going to leave the bypass live for 6 hours while we monitor. ping me if you see >1% image-pull failure in next hour. :thumbsup:
